buyNow.q: Can I buy a plan now?
buyNow.a: No. Mewvo runs only on its own server for now. Paid plans start when it opens to other servers; until then nothing can be bought and nobody is charged.

currency.a: You pay in US dollars or euros, depending on the language of this site: US dollars in English, Portuguese and Russian, euros in German, French, Italian, Spanish and Polish. The Polish and Portuguese pages also show an approximate amount in złoty or reais, based on the European Central Bank rate; the order summary and the receipt always show what you actually pay. The prices on this page are the planned monthly and yearly prices.

cancel.q: Can I cancel or get my money back?
cancel.a: Plans don’t renew by themselves, so there is nothing to cancel: a plan runs for the period you chose and then falls back to Free. Once real payments start, you can withdraw from a purchase within 14 days. If you asked for the plan to start right away, you get your money back minus the days you already used. Details are on the Withdrawal page.

freeKeeps.a: Everything Mewvo does today: enforcement, the warning ladder, appeals, automod, tickets, modmail, the dashboard and the community tools. Your case history is never deleted when a plan ends.

backToFree.q: What happens to extra tags or feeds if I go back to Free?
backToFree.a: The plan is that nothing is deleted: items over the Free limit stop working until you remove some or upgrade again. This may still change before launch.
